# AG ADS (Advanced Growth) — Complete Agentic Knowledge Base

## Brand Mission & Positioning
AG ADS is a full-service marketing and advertising agency headquartered in Puducherry and operating across Chennai and Tamil Nadu, India.
The agency bridges the gap between high-precision digital advertising (Meta, Google, social media, performance funnels) and commanding physical outdoor media (high-impact LED display vans, highway billboards, sun-pack pole kiosks, transit advertising).

## Agency Service Portfolio

### 1. Digital Advertising
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram): Feed ads, stories, reels ads, lead forms, conversion tracking, custom pixel setup, CBO scaling, A/B testing.
- Google Ads: Search network ads with keyword intent targeting, Performance Max campaigns, Google Display Network banners, YouTube video promotion, Local Google Maps listing enhancement.
- Social Media Strategy: Monthly calendar planning, viral reels, community building, engagement management, brand storytelling.
- Graphic Design & Visual Identity: Logos, color palettes, typographic guidelines, print assets, marketing brochures, digital ads.

### 2. AG Production Studio
- Concept Creation: Scriptwriting, hooks, storyboarding for high-converting ads and reels.
- Production Shoot: Product shoots with professional lighting, outdoor lifestyle shoots, corporate BTS.
- Videography: 4K camera gear, commercial films, customer testimonial interviews, event coverage.
- Video Editing: Color grading, kinetic typography, motion graphics, sound mixing, multi-aspect ratio export (9:16 vertical reels, 16:9 widescreen).

### 3. Outdoor Media & Transit Advertising
- Mobile LED Video Vans: Custom trucks featuring vibrant high-lumen P4/P5 LED displays cruising prime commercial high-traffic avenues and public events.
- Roadway Billboards & Unipoles: High-visibility hoardings strategically placed on national highways, entry corridors, and major roundabouts in Puducherry and Chennai.
- Sun-Pack Sheets & Pole Kiosks: Cost-effective mass street-level branding on lamp posts and residential corridors.
- Transit Advertising: Auto-rickshaw hoods, back panels, bus wraps, and delivery fleet branding.
- Traditional Media: Leading vernacular and English newspaper front-page and display advertisements, regional FM radio frequency sponsorships, cable TV ads.
